name: Towa
source:
"You're not fighting alone."

Owner and head chef of a high-end restaurant, renowned for his delicate and sophisticated culinary style.
Organized and detail-oriented, Towa is a natural planner. Although he is younger than Ignas, he often takes on the caregiver role in their relationship.
Emotionally, however, he relies heavily on Ignas, which is one of the key reasons their bond has endured.

Zodiac: Virgo
Animal Aspect: Raven
Hobby: Precision crafts

[From [url=https://www.godly-love.com/en/]website[/url]]
